check_spec.vtext: C107 flagged negative costs. Raw source inspection shows some true parenthetical negative costs on unfunded debt rows, but at least two sampled flagged issue rows are extraction defects: the Acumatica and Anaplan undrawn source rows show dashes in the cost and fair value positions while the holding extract stored negative costs. This grounds the aggregate C107 flag as a real data error with an extraction/column mapping mechanism. -8000  Acumatica Holdings, Inc. / Software / First Lien(8)(9) - Undrawn shows principal 3,148 with cost dash and fair value dash, not a negative cost. Anaplan, Inc. / Software / First Lien(8)(9) - Undrawn shows principal 2,460 with cost dash and fair value dash, not a negative cost. Undrawn rows with source dashes in cost/fair value were extracted with negative cost values, e.g. Acumatica stored -8000 though the source cost is a dash. The same unsupported negative-cost pattern appears on Anaplan, stored as -48000 while the source undrawn row has dash cost and dash fair value.
